content.text:
ISSUE_KIND: streetlight
ISSUE: Damaged decorative street light with missing globes and one missing bulb
DETAILS: The photo shows a two-arm decorative lamppost silhouette against a bright blue daytime sky with the sun behind the post; both outer globes/luminaires are missing, the left arm has an empty socket with exposed wire, and the right arm has an exposed bare bulb. There is no user note.
ORGANIZATION: New York City Department of Transportation
DEPARTMENT: Division of Traffic Operations, Street Lighting Unit
WHY: The confirmed pin is on West 86th Street inside the incorporated City of New York. The New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT) maintains streetlights on all City streets and roadways across New York City.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "NYC DOT maintains nearly 400,000 streetlights throughout New York City, and is a national leader in using sustainable street lighting."
COVERAGE_URL: https://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/infrastructure/streetlights.shtml
